name: Mark
reference: Pentagram and Collins identity launch films: a mark built from modules on a visible grid.
pattern: White, black and the brand colour, which the user supplies. The green here is only a placeholder.
personality: Construction. The mark assembles from simple modules, then holds.

motion.character: Modular: each part draws on by its outline, then fills and snaps to the grid with a small overshoot.
motion.transitions: The mark builds part by part on the grid; the grid stays until the lockup.

grammar: Show the grid while the mark builds, then hide it.
Build from no more than five modules.
End on the mark, held for two seconds.
needs: The brand mark as SVG and the brand colour.

pictures.note: No pictures: the mark is the subject.

hits.note: A small pop as each module lands; one impact when the mark resolves.

hook.how: The unit module of the mark, centred on frame 0, on a visible grid in ink: a path of `drawnMark` given a time at or before 0 is drawn and filled on frame 0. The paths of one mark count together as the picture.

compose.how: The pair stacks, line above, on the optical centre (lineAndSubject at the hook's area), inside the frame grid: when the module would pass the grid's foot, move the pair up so the module ends on it.

moves.move: The mark builds from at most five modules that snap to the grid on beats.

measurable.how: Each module lands within 2 frames of a beat.

moves.move: Each module draws on by its outline, then its fill lands on a beat; the grid stays until the lockup.
The wordmark locks up on the same grid: cap height and baseline on grid rows.

blocks.for: The visible grid while the mark builds.

props.mark: the brand mark: the name an SVG file was added under (untell media add <file>.svg --as <name>), or inline paths
props.accent: the one path in the brand colour (default: the first path, the unit module)
props.line: the one line over the mark while it builds; the block takes it off before the lockup
props.times: each module's draw on a beat; the unit module at or before 0
props.lockup: the name and its line, `at` on the bar

blocks.for: The mark, drawn on by its strokes, filled module by module, then locked up with the name.
Construction lines (the circle an arc of the mark comes from) while the mark builds.
The 2 s hold on the finished mark.
A pop as each module lands, one impact when the mark resolves.

props.mark: a flat shape, when the brief gives no SVG mark

blocks.for: The name with a flat mark on one axis, centred, when there is no brand mark to draw.

avoid.why: An identity film shows the mark, not a picture.
The mark is the subject, not words.

ends.how: The finished mark and the name as one lockup on one axis, centred, with the one impact, held 2 s. At 9:16 the name and its line go over the mark, so the mark keeps the size it was built at and the text stays in the text-safe area.
ends.with: `lockup: { name, line, at }` with `at` on the bar (the mark moves into place and the closing hold is marked), the one impact from `hit`

mix.note: Clean percussion. Every module lands on a beat.

shots.match: No pictures: the mark is the only subject.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a mark made of initials in a circle
